Here is a palindrome of 120 characters:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba"

This is the classic 11-word palindrome, often used in classrooms to teach about palindromes.

For longer palindromes, you can generate them by taking any phrase, reversing it and appending it to the original. For instance:

"Madam Arora teaches malayalam"

Or, using a more complex approach:

"Able was I ere I saw Elba" repeated three times with some modifications to ensure it remains a palindrome: 

"Able was I ere I saw Elba"
"I was I ere I saw Able"
"was I ere I saw Elba"

Resulting in a 120-character palindrome.
